'''Berylla Naron''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Blue Ajah]]. She was also [[Black Ajah]] and part of [[Liandrin's Group of Black Sisters]].

== Appearance ==
Berylla is lean, almost to scrawniness. She has black hair and dark brown eyes.

==Strength and Abilities==
Berylla is of [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|low average]] strength for an Aes Sedai, with a [[One Power]] level of {{opsl|33}}. Among [[Liandrin's group of Black Sisters]], only [[Joiya Byir]] was weaker and [[Amico Nagoyin]] was her equal.

== History ==
Berylla is 67 years old. She was born in [[933 NE]] and went to the [[White Tower]] in [[948 NE]]. After seven years as a [[novice]] and five years as [[Accepted]], she was raised to the shawl in {{ne|960}}.

She is as fine a manipulator and plotter as there ever was.

==Activities==

She was part of the group led by [[Liandrin]] that left the White Tower and made for [[Tear]]. When the [[Stone of Tear]] fell to the [[Aiel]], the group fled to [[Tanchico]]. After their plans were foiled by [[Elayne Trakand]] and [[Nynaeve al'Meara]],  they were forced to leave.

When [[Moghedien]] took control of the group, she gave each member a mission. When receiving her orders, Berylla showed little expression.{{ref/book|5|18}}

Her fate is undisclosed.
